Definition: Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Chinneroth or Cinneroth or Chinnereth = "harps"; 1) the early name of the Sea of Galilee; 2) a town and district in Naphtali near the Sea of Galilee
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
